text: The Snap-on sponsor entry on Honda HRC Castrol's sponsors page names Snap-on Incorporated, the NYSE-listed tool maker of Kenosha, Wisconsin, as the company behind the brand. Snap-on's 2026 proxy statement lists only two beneficial owners of more than 5% of its common stock: The Vanguard Group (12.4%) and BlackRock, Inc. (8.0%).
short: Snap-on is Snap-on Incorporated, NYSE-listed; the only >5% holders are Vanguard (12.4%) and BlackRock (8.0%).
